about: ORGAN: pp_bridge.model_faces('ORGAN'), the Pixel Pitch model the sprite renderer draws, centred on its bounding box and scaled to fit a unit sphere

fields.P: the face's vertices, k x 3 (x, y, z; y up), in drawing order (a fan from the first vertex)
fields.emit: its colour is used as it is, unshaded
fields.gid: group id: 1 marks the ground group, anything else is the instrument (the sprite renderer maps it to 2)
fields.rgb: its colour, 0..255 (floats as the bridge gives them; the sprite renderer truncates each to an int)

name: ORGAN
note: faces are in the order the model builder made them; the sprite renderer draws them in this order (a later face wins only where it is strictly nearer). Lines (strings) are not part of the model.
